$comment: Registry of reusable ComfyUI workflows (API format). Add new workflows by dropping <name>.json here and adding an entry below. Every {{var}} gets substituted by site-forge before queueing; defaults below are applied first, then --set / manifest job vars.

qwen-image.title: Qwen-Image 2512 — flagship text→image
qwen-image.use_for: Hero art, brand imagery, and anything that needs READABLE TEXT inside the image (posters, signage, product mockups, UI screens). Best quality on this machine. ~30-60s per image after first load.

defaults.negative: low resolution, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, oversaturated, blurry text, distorted letters, watermark

var_docs.width/height: multiples of 16; 1328² default, use 1664x928 for wide heroes
var_docs.shift: 3.1 default; raise to ~4 for more detail, lower for softer

z-image-turbo.title: Z-Image Turbo — fast photoreal
z-image-turbo.use_for: Photorealistic textures, background plates, product shots, quick iterations. 8 steps, ~5-10s per image. Negative prompt is ignored (zeroed conditioning).

var_docs.width/height: 1024² default; supports arbitrary aspect ratios well

flux-schnell.title: FLUX.1 schnell — 4-step rapid ideation
flux-schnell.use_for: Fastest exploration (4 steps, ~5s). Great for moodboards, layout sketches, iterating on art direction before committing to Qwen. Negative prompt ignored.

sdxl.title: SDXL base 1.0 — LoRA ecosystem workhorse
sdxl.use_for: When you need a specific style LoRA later (huge ecosystem). Baseline quality below Qwen/Z-Image — keep for compatibility.

qwen-image-edit.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 — instruction-based editing
qwen-image-edit.use_for: Iterate on a generated asset with natural-language instructions ('make the sky dusk', 'replace the sign text with AURORA', 'add subtle fog'). Preserves the rest of the image. Requires --image (auto-uploaded).

var_docs.image: required — path to source image (relative to project or absolute)

ltxv-video.title: LTX-Video 13B 0.9.8 distilled — fast text→video
ltxv-video.use_for: Quick video drafts and background loops (abstract motion, gradients, particles, texture flyovers). ~20-60s per clip. Prompt with motion verbs; keep it simple.

defaults.negative: low quality, worst quality, deformed, distorted, motion smear, jittery motion

wan22-ti2v.title: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B — image→video (hero loops)
wan22-ti2v.use_for: Animate a generated hero image into a cinematic clip (the $10k-site pattern: Qwen image → Wan animation). Slower but highest quality. Draft at 832x480x65, final at 1280x704x121.

defaults.negative: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

var_docs.prompt: required — describe the motion to add to the image
